issue.title: Clan-scoped toobig chop launches
issue.description: Every toobig_split run launches its accepted split-file agents as one toobig-@ clan, and Axe prevents another run while an active clan whose name starts with toobig- exists.

issue.title: Shared chop contracts and guard engine
issue.description: 'Shared chop contracts and guard engine' section: extend the Rust chop wire, validation, and decision engine with clan-aware proposals and active agent-clan prefix guards.

issue.title: SASE runtime, SDK, and configuration integration
issue.description: 'SASE runtime, SDK, and configuration integration' section: expose the core contracts through Python, batch clan-scoped proposals safely, snapshot active clan metadata, document the config, and preserve legacy launches.

issue.title: toobig_split clan emission
issue.description: 'toobig_split clan emission' section: update bugyi-chops so one scan emits stable member IDs in a shared toobig-@ clan while retaining its wait chain and dedupe behavior.

issue.title: Athena rollout and end-to-end verification
issue.description: 'Athena rollout and end-to-end verification' section: deploy compatible SASE and bugyi-chops releases, switch the configured guard to the toobig- clan prefix, and verify fire, skip, and rerun behavior.

fields.notes: Implemented in linked sase-core: added optional clan launch-proposal wire support with clan/member identity validation; added agent_clan guard config validation, canonical snapshot metadata, and active-prefix decision evaluation; added Rust and PyO3 parity coverage. Verified with cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace.

Implemented clan-aware chop orchestration: Python SDK clan contracts, canonical active-clan guard snapshots, side-effect-free planning plus atomic multi-prompt clan batches, full-name wait resolution, dedupe head promotion, partial-launch durability, schema/rendering/docs updates, and legacy non-clan compatibility. Verified focused suites, full pytest (19,478 passed, 7 skipped), formatting/type/lint/validation checks; repository-wide just check is blocked only by the unrelated stale Symvision sase-7p epic-symbol exemption.

Implemented clan-aware chop orchestration: Python SDK clan contracts, canonical active-clan guard snapshots, side-effect-free planning plus atomic multi-prompt clan batches, full-name wait resolution, dedupe head promotion, partial-launch durability, schema/rendering/docs updates, and legacy non-clan compatibility. Focused tests and formatting/type/lint/validation checks passed. The full pytest run recorded 19,478 passes and 7 skips plus one transient visual snapshot mismatch, which passed on isolated rerun. Repository-wide just check is blocked only by the unrelated stale Symvision sase-7p epic-symbol exemption.

Implemented bugyi-chops clan emission: every toobig_split proposal now uses clan=toobig-@ with deterministic marker-free split_file member IDs; preserved prompt, proposal ID, wait chain, workspace, and content dedupe behavior; updated README policy/examples. Verified with BUGYI_CHOPS_VENV_BIN=<SASE venv> just check (29 tests, 92.48% coverage, lint/type/build/twine all pass). Existing sase>=0.12.0,<0.13.0 floor already targets the first compatible SASE release.

Completed Athena rollout: updated the managed toobig_split guard to agent_clan name_prefix=toobig-, updated the SASE/core/bugyi-chops runtime, reapplied the live config, and restarted Axe. Fixed script-chop action dedupe so an active clan guard yields a named skip before launched-run dedupe and --force can dispatch. Isolated synthetic E2E verified dry-run clan planning/no launch, first fire, named active-clan skip, forced rerun, and ordinary rerun after terminal completion. Verification: focused 38 tests passed, primary just check passed, chezmoi just check passed, Chop Doctor OK, and all nine production lumberjacks running.
